"''Well, I have a ship docking in the lower hangar as we speak.|Aayla Secura and Anakin Skywalker|}} A '''Republic frigate''' was part of the [[Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] used it to evacuate [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Aayla Secura]] and some of her [[troop]]s from her [[flagship]] [[Liberty (Venator-class)|''Liberty'']] during the [[Battle of Quell]]. However, during the [[frigate]]'s attempt to return to Skywalker's [[flagship]], the ''[[Resolute]]'', the [[Starship|ship]] was damaged by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] fire, killing the pilot and causing the [[hyperdrive]] to activate, flinging the starship into [[hyperspace]] on an unknown trajectory, carrying both [[Jedi]] [[General]]s, Skywalker's [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], [[Clone Commander]] [[Bly]], [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]], and [[clone trooper]]s [[Lucky]], [[Flash]], and [[Cameron]]. Skywalker had also been severely injured holding back an explosion while the others boarded the ship. The damage to the ship's [[hyperdrive]] caused it to enter a collision course with the [[Maridun's star|sun]] of the [[Maridun system]], with the stellar collision only averted by the ship's power being completely shut off, forcing it out of [[hyperspace]] and allowing Tano and Bly, who were flying, to divert the ship's course around the star. However, the damage to the ship forced it to crash-land on the [[planet]] [[Maridun]]. {{Ship-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Jedi Crash}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Women of the Galaxy]]'' {{Imo}} *{{FFGXW2|set=LAAT/i Gunship Expansion Pack|cardname=Aayla Secura (Crew)}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Retrofitted Consular-class cruisers]] [[Category:Starships of the Galactic Republic]]
